# DecisionCategory()

> **DecisionCategory**(`spec`: [`DecisionCategorySpec`](../interfaces/DecisionCategorySpec.md)): [`IdentifiedDefinition`](../interfaces/IdentifiedDefinition.md)

Defined in: [src/sdk/index.ts:317](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/index.ts#L317)

Group decisions under one category. `available` checks whether a decision may be taken; `completeEffect` describes the effect of taking it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `spec` | [`DecisionCategorySpec`](../interfaces/DecisionCategorySpec.md) |

## Returns

[`IdentifiedDefinition`](../interfaces/IdentifiedDefinition.md)

## Example

```ts
DecisionCategory({ id: "council_budget", decisions: [{
  id: "council_vote", cost: 25,
  available: country => !country.isAI,
  completeEffect: country => country.effects.setCountryFlag("council_voted"),
}] });
```
